activity_summary: Nick walked in the watchet gown, sleeves long, and the fifty shillings stayed unpaid. Phillips took Sam through the cuckoo song on the breath. Sam forgot where to stand and kept every note. You set him left of Nick. Kemp stayed quiet for the song. Garnish wrote no total.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ordered the gown and the song first, set Sam left of Nick, and kept the column blank.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Walked in the watchet, and would not turn to find Sam.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Taught the song on the breath, not on the word, and named the loss a right one.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Forgot where to stand and remembered every note.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Entered Sam left of the Princess and wrote no total.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Said a lost tune cannot be covered with talk.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stayed quiet for the song, and said so.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The watchet gown, and the song

facets.activity: Rehearsed the watchet gown and the cuckoo song

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.

quotes.speaker: sam_latchet
quotes.text: I had the place and I lost it.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Fifty shillings of it is still on the Cheapside book.
